description:
IMHentai gallery page (/gallery//), 'gallery adults' engine as served without JS. div.row.gallery_first > div.left_cover > a > img.lazy whose real cover is in data-src (https://m9.imhentai.xxx/025/h4d8fg6ngb/cover.jpg) while src is a loading_cover.gif placeholder; og:image repeats the cover. div.right_details > h1 with the FULL bracketed title including a scanlator '[Quill Zqvd]' and '[Decensored]' in the tail, p.subtitle with the Japanese title; ul.galleries_info with one
  • per row: span.tags_text label ('Parodies:', 'Characters:', 'Tags:', 'Artists:', 'Groups:', 'Languages:', 'Category:') followed by SINGLE-QUOTED a.tag links 'name 9,874' (comma counts); the parody is a combined nhentai entity rendered as 'penvxcz | quill cuoi' (two names, one link); the language link carries a flag ; 'Pages: 28' and 'Posted: September 14, 2024' are both li.pages with no label span. Noise: navbar logo , Browse dropdown to plural index pages, a Categories dropdown linking every format word (/category/manga/ … /category/cosplay/), a Languages dropdown (/language/english/ /language/japanese/ …), search box (name=key), exoclick zones and a 728x90 banner between the info block and the 12 page thumbnails (div.gthumb img.lazy[data-src=…/Nt.jpg]), hidden inputs gallery_id/load_id/load_dir/load_pages/load_server, 'Related' with six other galleries (div.thumb > div.inner_thumb img.lazy[data-src=…/thumb.jpg] + flag image, a.thumb_cat category link, div.caption full bracketed titles by OTHER circles/artists, one by the same circle, one Chinese, one artist cg), a comments block whose text names another artist and the tags 'netorare', 'ahegao', 'full color', a commenter account named after the scanlator, footer logo and links, and the g_th $.parseJSON blob. Unsure: the exact spacing/quoting of the tag rows (gallery-dl's IMHentai extractor matches "badge'>" and "href='/category/", so single quotes there), whether split_tag text includes the '| ' (Mihon's GalleryAdults strips a '| ' prefix from it), the Posted date format (Mihon parses it from '.pages:contains(Posted:)'), whether IMHentai shows comments at all and their markup, the related block's title/markup and the ad snippets; the gallery and all names are invented.
